title: Joint fasting glucose–HbA1c splines did not improve cross-cycle prediction of urinary albumin excretion
abstract: In exploratory NHANES 2009–2010 to 2015–2016 transfer, a fixed glucose-by-HbA1c spline tensor increased weighted log(1+UACR) MSE from 0.717203 to 0.731621; incremental predictive value was not demonstrated, and source-refit uncertainty was unstable. A scaling-floor sensitivity retained higher point error but an interval crossing zero. The analysis is exploratory, not untouched confirmation or a causal or equivalence claim.
